pr_title: VCP and MICP: AICS and VOCS count fix
pr_body:
Add early returns if the count is 0. 

This does not change anything as the function themselves are not called when it is 0, but this fixes a coverity issue. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/59523
fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/59531

review_comments:
They should give the same result, right? IMO `IS_ENABLED` makes more sense to use for bool values.

e.g. if I do 
```c
if (CONFIG_BT_MICP_MIC_DEV_AICS_INSTANCE_COUNT > 100) {
    qq; /* invalid code */
}
```

I still get a compiler warning, even if `CONFIG_BT_MICP_MIC_DEV_AICS_INSTANCE_COUNT < 100`. So I think that `CONFIG_FOO > X` for ints yields the same as `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_FOO)` for bools, i.e. it is compiled but not linked
